**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve dynamic accessible name for finish-time metadata**

The finish-time element is now keyboard-focusable and has an explicit `aria-label`, but it is wrapped in a MUI `Tooltip` without `describeChild`. In MUI, tooltip `title` is used as the child’s accessible label by default, so assistive tech may announce only the static tooltip text (“Estimated wall-clock finish time”) instead of the dynamic finish time you intended. This regresses the accessibility goal for keyboard/screen-reader users on paused/active task rows; use `describeChild` (or equivalent labeling strategy) so the tooltip becomes a description rather than replacing the control’s label.
